title: Geometric regularity descends along a flat morphism of locally Noetherian schemes over a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to Y of locally Noetherian schemes over k, if X is geometrically regular at a point x and f is flat there, the lemma concludes that Y is geometrically regular at the image point, with the global statement following when f is additionally surjective (statement lines 2510-2519). The proof tests the definition on a finite purely inseparable extension: it base changes f, takes the unique point above x, notes that flatness is preserved by the base change, and then observes that the induced map on local rings is a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings whose target is regular by hypothesis, so the source is regular by the algebra lemma on flat descent of regularity (proof lines 2521-2540). The pointwise criterion then gives geometric regularity of Y at y. The claim is H2: a short reduction to the algebraic descent statement, with the preservation of flatness and the uniqueness of the lifted point as the two supporting observations.
